description: INFLUENCE — ask to be shown less, or not at all. `restricted` keeps a name, a description and a link to your own site, unrated and out of every ranked view; `delisted` removes you entirely. Returns 202 and is applied by a person: it strips artifacts, pages and rollups across the network, which is not something to do irreversibly on one API call. Priced B4 (human work) — worked by a person, no charge. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.
